events.details: Before successful replay, corrected checker assumptions for static team slot metadata, model-period versus raw-period identity, and official metric wrapper field subsets. Frozen runner, input arrays and scored outputs were unchanged. Corrected historical scalar IoU-F1 versus current full IoU-object comparison; added a matching/mismatching synthetic self-test. A fast saved-row audit then passed all 900 rows, baseline comparisons, 108 summaries and 11 screens before the final full replay.

An audit session lost its execution transport and exited without a verification receipt. It was not counted as verified. Restarted the independent replay with persistent logging and process workers; removed redundant metric passes while retaining all 900 decoded probability/metric/diagnostic checks.
